scope: Exploratory continuous 3D-distance assessment on all630 unchanged returned routes. No new optimizer campaign, no objective change, no change to primary feasibility or tests.
surface: The original complete bilinear height-field graph over the modeled map domain, not the stepped display, not reconstructed architectural solids.
distance: Minimum Euclidean distance between the six complete route segments and the continuous bilinear surface.
bounds: Spatial hierarchy with exact piecewise-quadratic segment/AABB lower bounds. Bilinear leaf subdivision adds triangle-mesh lower bounds reduced by |bilinear cross coefficient|/4. Surface points projected onto the route give upper bounds.
classification: Upper<8: below8; lower>=8: atLeast8; otherwise refine then retain unresolved if the interval straddles8. Original vertical feasibility is a separate quantity.
numericalAllowance: AABB lower distances subtract1e-9. Triangle bounds subtract1e-8. Upper witness distances add1e-9. Floating-point geometrical bounds, not a formal interval-arithmetic proof.
witnesses: All returned surface points are re-evaluated on original bilinear cells; route points are checked by independent segment projection.
preservation: All630 raw file hashes and originalCSV source identity checked. Failures/unconverged cases retained, not removed.
